title: Marriage Customs
summary: The ceremonies and exchanges that unite families.
body: Marriage among the Murle is as much a union between families as it is between individuals. Negotiations often involve extended family members and can span an extended period as arrangements are carefully discussed.

Cattle traditionally play a central role in marriage exchanges, symbolizing respect between families and formalizing the new bond. The specific terms vary based on family circumstances and clan customs.
Ceremonies bring communities together in celebration, featuring music, dance, and shared meals that reflect the broader social importance of the occasion.
